what: 2.319 r2 controls: the real Q.STROKE rows (Q.STROKE_OWNER mask and family) of each note's cell, the cell's flag boxes with the strokes each covers (Q.GLYPH_STROKES), and the one count's state. truth = beams or flags on the stem by the print (agent's look at the 600 dpi page): Litolff p4 1/8/5 five beamed eighths with a box on the beam's end read as a head (glyph 19, no stem); Brahms p25 0/3/1 two flagged eighths, the second under a false clefF box; Litolff p4 1/1/12 a flagged eighth after the barline. group = notes sharing a printed beam share a letter, '-' = no beam, 'x' = not a note.
